node.label: Joint contracture of the 5th finger
node.definition: Chronic loss of joint motion in the 5th finger due to structural changes in non-bony tissue. The term camptodactyly of the 5th finger is used if the distal and/or proximal interphalangeal joints are affected.

evidence.snippet: Oculodentodigital dysplasia: Joint contracture of the 5th finger (frequency 15/18) [PCS]
